verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say developers can build with 'one of our many SDKs', and it also offers a CLI `generate` command that produces a type-safe SDK tailored to the project's schema. Messaging and Functions docs refer to SDK methods, and agent skills and the MCP server carry SDK-specific context. The pack never lists which languages or platforms the SDKs cover, how deep their API coverage goes, or how they are versioned, so the story is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: enumeration of official SDK languages/platforms, SDK reference documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can use one of our many SDKs or integrate directly through the REST API or GraphQL API.
The generate command creates a type-safe SDK tailored to your project.
Send on every channel from one Messaging service and SDK.
Skills are open-source Markdown files that give AI agents deep knowledge of Appwrite SDKs and services.
